S17 (the '+' check dropped): no header starts one byte past where a stream's reading started unless that byte is a sign. streamStart is the first byte of the stream's own header number; the walk takes a digit run whole, and the comment path starts a header at an integer token's start; and a reading at a one-byte number followed by a signed integer is no header.
